item.title: UPSC CDS 2020 Recruitment: Candidates should check notification, other details at upsc.gov.in or upsconline.nic.in
item.description: UPSC CDS 2020 Recruitment: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for Combined Defence Services (CDS) 2020 at its official website-upsc.gov.in/upsconline.nic.in. According to the UPSC notification, UPSC CDS online application starts from 30th October 2019 and will continue till 19th November 2019. item.title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman
item.description: Slabs and rates are being changed across the board to benefit all taxpayers. The new structure will substantially reduce the taxes of the middle class and leave more money in their hands, boosting household consumption, savings and investment. As a result of these proposals, revenue of about Rs 1 lakh crore in direct taxes and Rs 2600 crore in indirect taxes will be forgone. Image:

item.title: PM Narendra Modi
item.description: Tax reductions across all income groups will provide immense relief to the middle class. This will also create great opportunities for young professionals who have recently entered the workforce. Irrigation and infrastructure development will take place in 100 districts under this scheme. Additionally, the Kisan Credit Card limit has been raised to Rs 5 lakh, ensuring more financial support for farmers. Image:

item.title: Home Minister Amit Shah
item.description: The proposal on zero income tax till Rs 12 lakh income will go a long way in enhancing the financial well-being of the middle class.
